scope: Make production combat-kill, XP-rate, and quest metrics describe PRE-CU skill-box combat difficulty instead of the removed NGE player combat level while preserving authored NPC level, metric schemas, and gameplay reward behavior.

findings: Publish 14.1 derives player combat capability from learned weapon skill modifiers and skill boxes rather than an NGE profession level.
The shared PRE-CU encounter adapter maps learned combat skill-box investment to a hidden compatibility score and is already authoritative for group difficulty.
metrics.doKillMetrics is called by the active combat-XP path, metrics.doXpRateMetrics is called by XP awards, and metrics.doQuestMetrics is called by quest completion.
The production metric library retained four raw player-level reads even though its group metric already used PRE-CU group difficulty.
The defeated creature's authored getLevel(target) value remains correct descriptive content and is intentionally preserved.

buildEvidence.hostMaterializationWorkflow: retired; direct source is mounted read-only and the existing Docker work volume is used
buildEvidence.sourceTest: passed; all four player metric fields use PRE-CU skill difficulty, group difficulty remains PRE-CU, the one authored creature level remains, and all three production call sites and log schemas are preserved
